tips_en: Read MC-Lens first: it is the most conceptually expansive, showing how multimodal concepts become internally readable yet selectively accessed in VLMs, and its counterfactual intervention and Jacobian-alignment toolkit is reusable on the other two papers' models. Next take cmHC, whose geometric contraction of the Birkhoff polytope is a crisp, tightly proved refinement of Hyper-Connections with concrete Ascend latency gains. Finish with NoPeWorld, the most applied piece — the claim that frozen DiT hidden states anticipate obstacle contact before pixels appear, plus a 74%→16% violation drop, makes it a satisfying payoff; note that all three share a theme of controlling or revealing how information flows between components of a system.
tips_zh: 建议先读 MC-Lens：它概念性最强，揭示多模态概念在 VLM 内部何时变得可读、何时被选择性访问，其反事实干预与 Jacobian 对齐方法也可复用于另外两篇的模型。随后读 cmHC：它对 Birkhoff 多胞形做几何收缩，是对 Hyper-Connections 边界清晰、证明严密且有真实昇腾加速收益的改进。最后读 NoPeWorld：应用性最强，冻结的 DiT 隐状态在像素生成前即可预判障碍接触，加上违规率从 74% 降到 16%，结论很有说服力；值得注意的是三篇都围绕同一主线——如何控制或揭示模型内部组件之间的信息流动。
